dataset: FoodSeg103 pretrained external segmentation model; not trained on NutriVision test data
sampling: 100 unique test dishes randomly selected with seed 42; lexicographically first frame per dish; pilot uses first 10
mask: argmax food class != 0; nearest resize to original image size; remove connected components under 25 pixels
limitations: Automatic masks require visual review. Two dimensional visible food regions, not volume. Observational associations do not show causal dependence. Area and contour features reflect multiple ingredients and camera framing.
external_model_card_metric: Author reports 23.33% multiclass validation mIoU on FoodSeg103, not a Nutrition5k foreground-mask accuracy estimate
source_download: Same public checkpoint downloaded via hf-mirror.com because the primary host was unreachable
visual_qa: All 100 masks visually screened; per-sample decisions and reasons are in shape_features_reviewed.csv
